ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: anò ne ḿboŋo wɔ́ɔn tɛʼ páʼ mèŋ zsě gú
o la' ntuntu: ano ne mbongo woon te' pa' meng zse gu

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: pɔgɔ pumte ncwò nzěm/ pɔgɔ pumte jǔɔ
o la' ntuntu: pogo pumte ncwo nzem pogo pumte juo

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: mèŋ ne ńtsɔ́ɔn létoŋo gú tsɔ́ jʉʼ
o la' ntuntu: meng ne ntsoon letongo gu tso ju'

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: mèŋ nge tó faʼa gú ná tẅɛ̂b
o la' ntuntu: meng nge to fa'a gu na tweb

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: wɔɔn nèm ntʉ́a lê ntsɔ̀b ntʉ́a
o la' ntuntu: woon nem ntua le ntsob ntua

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: nèm ntʉ́a zaga nkùnkwɔ̀ɔn ntsɔ̀b ntʉ́a
o la' ntuntu: nem ntua zaga nkunkwoon ntsob ntua

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: mèŋ n ne ńtsɔ́ɔn lépfɛɛ mmó
o la' ntuntu: meng n ne ntsoon lepfee mmo

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: mèŋ n ne ńtsɔ́ɔn  mmó gie n ge núu
o la' ntuntu: meng n ne ntsoon mmo gie n ge nuu

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: tsétsɔʼ,mèŋ n ge ḿbág letsye sɔ́ɔn
o la' ntuntu: tsetso' meng n ge mbag letsye soon

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: pi gẅiin shúm sie ngwɔ́ mé pfɛ́ mbÿag?
o la' ntuntu: pi gwiin shum sie ngwo me pfe mbyag

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: ngwɔ́ mèŋ n gyɛ́ mbelég nzɔ̌?
o la' ntuntu: ngwo meng n gye mbeleg nzo

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: mèŋ n né ńkwoŋo pípà nzẅìŋ
o la' ntuntu: meng n ne nkwongo pipa nzwing

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: ngwɔ́ pi gẅiin kɔ́ lɔg ḿbɔ́ɔn legyáŋ?
o la' ntuntu: ngwo pi gwiin ko log mboon legyang

ɔ̀ láʼ ntʉntʉ́?: á té ne ńkúu twó mèŋ wɔ́
o la' ntuntu: a te ne nkuu two meng wo
